items.title: Understand
items.description: We start with your business, not your website. Who you serve, what you sell, what a good outcome looks like and what's blocking it today.

items.title: Plan
items.description: Structure, content, features and technical approach get defined before any design work begins — so nothing important gets discovered late.

items.title: Design
items.description: Visual direction and user experience take shape: layout, typography, colour, hierarchy and the details that make it feel considered.

items.title: Build
items.description: Development using clean, documented, component-driven code — responsive from the first commit, not retrofitted at the end.

items.title: Test
items.description: Responsiveness, forms, performance, accessibility and cross-browser behaviour get checked properly — on real screen sizes, not just one laptop.

items.title: Launch
items.description: Deployment, domain and hosting configuration, analytics, search console, redirects and a final pre-launch review before going live.

items.title: Improve
items.description: Launch is a milestone, not the finish line. We keep refining based on how people actually use the site and how the business evolves.
